evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 8.9 → 10.1 → 18.2 → 24.3 ppm after having settled at ~5-7 ppm
Tube pressure creeping up 2.998 → 3.212 Torr at constant Ar setpoint/flow
Ar flow steady near 100 sccm, so the pressure/O2 rise is not from a flow change
Temperature control nominal at 750 °C with plausible heater power

args.missing_evidence: A flow/pressure isolation test (e.g., pump-down or Ar shutoff leak-up rate) to distinguish an air in-leak at a seal from an exhaust restriction; continued O2/P trend over next events.
